en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a broad, tree-lined avenue with a central carriageway sloping gently upward into the distance. People and carriages are visible on the street. Elegant multi‑story buildings flank both sides, and there are lampposts and a small open square or intersection in the foreground. Decorative printed text and stamps appear on the front, including red lettering and a circular stamp at the lower left that reads "Souvenir d'Athènes." The caption printed in Greek and French at the bottom right identifies the street.
